section.title: Loading the orders page
section.scenario: The account orders page lists every order an account placed this quarter, which is 200 orders for a typical account, each row showing the customer's name. Both versions render the same table.
section.question: Which piece should this page use, and which stated fact decides it?
section.piece_a: class OrdersController < ApplicationController def index @orders = current_account.orders .order(created_at: :desc) end end # index.html.erb <% @orders.each do |order| %> <%= order.number %> <%= order.customer.name %> <% end %>
section.piece_b: class OrdersController < ApplicationController def index @orders = current_account.orders .includes(:customer) .order(created_at: :desc) end end # index.html.erb <% @orders.each do |order| %> <%= order.number %> <%= order.customer.name %> <% end %>
